title: Silent Failure and Defect Masking
pattern: Catching all errors in core business transactions or critical calculations and returning a neutral default value (e.g., `0.0` or empty) to "fail gracefully."
why_bad: It silently corrupts business state and hides critical infrastructure failures from operators. Graceful degradation should only be applied to non-critical, optional services (e.g., recommendations, ads), never to core financial or transactional data [100].
detection: Identify catch-all error handling blocks within core domain or transactional logic that default to dummy or zeroed values instead of propagating the error or panicking.
fix: Propagate critical errors up the stack so the system fails loud, alerts operators, and blocks further state corruption.
source: Marianne Bellotti, *Kill It with Fire*, page 114 / passage [100].
